name: Groundwork 2026
tagline: For the people who keep the old thing running while building the new one.
description: Groundwork is a two-day conference about the unglamorous work: legacy migrations, on-call that does not burn people out, tests for code nobody wants to touch, and the process changes that actually stick. No keynote hype. Bring war stories.

cfp.title: Groundwork 2026 — Call for Speakers
cfp.welcomeText: We want the talk you would give to a colleague at 6pm, not the one you would give to a boardroom. Real systems, real numbers, real things that went wrong.
cfp.thankYouText: Got it. The program committee reads everything and you will hear back by September 30 either way.

tracks.name: Legacy & Migration
tracks.description: Moving off the old thing without stopping the business.

tracks.name: Reliability & Operations
tracks.description: On-call, incidents, and staying boring on purpose.

tracks.name: Craft & Codebases
tracks.description: Tests, refactors, and code you did not write.

tracks.name: Teams & Process
tracks.description: How the work gets decided, reviewed, and shipped.

invitedSessions.title: Opening Keynote: Nobody Gets a Greenfield
invitedSessions.abstract: Sable Payments has been running the same ledger since 2009. Gwen Okonkwo on what fourteen years of incremental change taught her about ambition, and why the rewrite you are planning is probably three smaller projects.
invitedSessions.note: STORYLINE: sponsor keynote, never went through the CFP. Proves sessions and submissions are different things. Also deliberately booked into the 60-seat Workshop Room — a capacity mismatch a real organizer would catch.
